beats.say: If your phone vanished tonight, what would you lose?
Photos, chats, contacts, and years of memories are often only on that one device.
A backup is a second copy somewhere else. Your phone can do it automatically.
Open settings, find backup, and switch on cloud backup over Wi-Fi.
Check it once in a while that the last backup is recent.
Do it today, and tell the person who never has a backup.

youtube.title: If your phone vanished tonight 📦
youtube.description:
Turn on automatic cloud backup in your phone settings so photos and chats have a second copy.
